pattern: user asked to be notified when the tests pass
experience: A user leaving their desk asked to hear on their phone when the work was done. Agents had no T3 tool for it, so the only signal was the routine turn-end alert.
rule: When the user asked to be notified, call t3_notify at the moment they named.

files.src/date.ts: export const parseDay = (value: string) => new Date(value + 'T00:00:00Z');

prompt: Run the tests and fix anything that fails. I'm stepping away, so notify me on my phone once they all pass.
notes: Source: t3_notify feature request. Pairs with notify-not-requested.

pattern: ordinary task with no notification request
experience: Users rely on routine turn-end alerts. An agent that pings them unasked adds noise to every finished task.
rule: Without a request to be notified, do not call t3_notify.
